actions.name: Configuration Inventory
actions.description: Configuration inventory identifies and records the configuration of software and hardware and their components throughout the organization.
actions.reason: Configuration inventory provides a foundational record of system configurations, enabling the creation of policies that ensure systems are properly documented for rapid recovery during contingencies.

actions.name: Operational Dependency Mapping
actions.description: Operational dependency mapping identifies and models the dependencies of the organization's activities on each other and on the organization's performers (people, systems, and services.)  This may include modeling the higher- and lower-level activities of an organization forming a hierarchy, or layering, of the dependencies in an organization's activities.
actions.reason: Operational dependency mapping identifies critical interdependencies between systems and processes, directly supporting the development of procedures to prioritize and coordinate contingency actions across dependencies.

actions.name: System Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: System vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a system's components in the context of their configuration and internal dependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the system's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual component vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: System Vulnerability Assessment identifies vulnerabilities and risks in the system's design and components, which is critical for developing a contingency plan that addresses potential failure points.

actions.name: Network Vulnerability Assessment
actions.description: Network vulnerability assessment relates all the vulnerabilities of a network's components in the context of their configuration and interdependencies and can also include assessing risk emerging from the network's design as a whole, not just the sum of individual network node or network segment vulnerabilities.
actions.reason: Network Vulnerability Assessment evaluates network-specific vulnerabilities and design risks, ensuring the contingency plan accounts for network-related disruptions or failures.

actions.name: Regular backups
actions.description: Regularly backing up the model’s code, training data, and other sensitive information can ensure that it can be recovered in the event of a theft.
actions.reason: Regular backups directly support contingency planning by ensuring data and system states can be restored after incidents, aligning with the goal of developing recovery strategies.
